## Vulchling (CR 1/2)

**XP** 200  
 CE Medium magical beast  
 **Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +0 (+8 in daylight)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 14, touch 13, flat-footed 11 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +1 natural)  
 **hp** 10 (1d10)  
 **Fort** +2, **Ref** +4, **Will** +0  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 20 ft., fly 10 ft. (average)  
 **Melee** bite +3 (1d6+2), 2 claws +3 (1d4+2)  

**Tactics**

 Vulchlings prefer to attack from secret or ambush by lying in wait for their prey and then swooping in to attack with their razor-sharp talons and beak. Slain opponents are carried back to the vulchlings’ lair and fed to the young vulchlings.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 10, **Dex** 14, **Con** 11, **Int** 7, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 10  
 **Base Atk** +1; **CMB** +3; **CMD** 14  
 **Feats** DodgeB, Weapon Finesse  
*House rules: Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
 **Skills** Perception +0 (+8 in daylight), Stealth +6; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Perception in daylight  
 **Languages** Auran  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any underground  
 **Organization** solitary or flock (2-16)  
 **Treasure** standard
